summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity running studies on sources of lead exposure in low- and middle-income countries, so governments and others can act on them, modelled for West Africa. The idea Lead Research for Action was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its final cost per DALY equivalent.
